searchText: The EIP 4337 spec describes UserOperation as: `Like a transaction, it contains “sender”, “to”, “calldata”, “maxFeePerGas”...`. However, I don't see where I set the `to` field in any of the examples. https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4337#definitions. What am I missing? Why doomed just catching up on the thread 🙂 I thought the spec actually has support for data contracts It’s used by art blocks and a few others in the space A small growing contingent of folks that want to efficiently store just data for later retrieval With less gas Excellent question, wrong channel. Ask in the associated "discussions-to" link here - https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-4337-account-abstraction-via-entry-point-contract-specification/7160
